name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
summary: Income support of ₹6,000/year for all landholding farmer families.
eligibilityCriteria: Total cultivable land under 2 hectares preferred (priority category)
benefits: ₹2,000 paid every 4 months directly to your bank account.
howToApply: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or apply online via the PM-KISAN portal with your land records and Aadhaar.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance covering yield losses from natural calamities, pests, and disease.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Must enroll before the cut-off date for the season
benefits: Low premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi) with full sum insured on crop loss.
howToApply: Apply through your bank branch, CSC, or the PMFBY mobile app before the sowing season deadline.

name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya
summary: Subsidy for farm ponds, polythene lining, and micro-irrigation to improve water security.
eligibilityCriteria: Priority given to rainfed farmers and drought-prone taluks
benefits: Up to 80% subsidy on farm pond construction and drip/sprinkler irrigation sets.
howToApply: Apply at your local Raitha Samparka Kendra with land records and Aadhaar-linked bank passbook.
